address: Shop 403, 4F, Ocean Centre, Harbour City, 3-27 Canton Road, Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, Hong Kong SAR China
bio: Have a drink on the patio before sampling a line-up that is French in essence but enhanced by subtle Japanese touches. The Singaporean chef honed his skills in top establishments around Europe and Asia. He ingeniously matches flavours and textures in precisely executed dishes that are not overly fancy. The two tasting menus are paired with carefully curated wines. The next-door cafe is a great spot for afternoon tea....
